summary: Formbricks is a self-hosted open-source experience-management / survey platform: build and run link or in-app surveys, collect responses, attribute them to contacts via custom attributes, target respondents by segments, enforce response quotas, push responses to webhooks/integrations, organize everything by organization->workspace with role-based memberships and API keys, and automate follow-up with a workflow engine. This spec exposes the management surface: surveys (CRUD, archive/restore, status lifecycle), action classes, segments, quotas, responses and displays, tags on responses, webhooks, contacts and attribute keys, invites/teams/memberships, organizations/workspaces, users, feedback sources and workflows. Auth is a single user account (email + password) signing into an organization via membership.
